title: LIGHTS ON: Claude Opus 5.5 launch trailer (locked cut)
logline: In a cathedral-sized dark hall, one clay cursor learns to code and wave one goes from capability to budget in about 5 months. Then the camera pulls back: code was one lit box on a dark delivery line, 16% of developer time. Work arriving at agent speed piles into towers at human-speed stations, and the reflex to add more agents makes the errors worse. In silence someone asks who runs the line. The lights come on bank by bank, graph, hierarchy and swarm lock into place, and the dark mass at the back of the hall, which we took for architecture, lights from its core: the foreman, Claude Opus 5.5. The clock restarts at MONTH 1.
world:
ONE PLACE, ONE PROTAGONIST LIGHT, ONE COLOR PLOT (cold to warm). Units are scene units (u); 1.8u = one human. y is up; work flows along +x (left to right on screen in every flow shot).

PALETTE PER ACT (hex):
- COLD OPEN (flash-forward, degraded): void #050506, amber rail light #FFB070, clay #D97757 (max 10% of frame), brass #F3D9B1 -> #B88A5A -> #4A3626. Fog color #0B0907, density x2, exposure -1 stop, sat 0.9. The rewind drains to steel #5B7A93.
- ACT I: void #050506, slate #141413, graphite #262624, steel #5B7A93, ice #CFE3F2. Clay #D97757 is the ONLY warm hue (the cursor and the code-station orbs): 2% of frame, rising to about 5% when the code tower blazes. sat 0.8, tint [0.96,1.0,1.06].
- MIDPOINT: near-black, ice hairlines #5B7A93 at 8% brightness, exactly one clay segment.
- ACT II: cold desaturated (sat 0.75), ice whites #CFE3F2, card ivory #E8E6DF, alert red #FF453A as pinpoints only (1% of frame or less; never a full-field red), clay protagonist dimmed to 30%.
- DROP: pure black, ivory #FAF9F5 mono type.
- ACT III: warm. Clay #D97757 / ember #FF8A5C are reserved for CLAUDE (the foreman core, its 12 threads, its sub-leads, the 100-agent team, the Stripe session). Neutral structure (the graph, hierarchy and swarm diagrams and the Google-study coordinator) is ivory #FAF9F5, ice #CFE3F2 and brass #E8B47A, never clay. Lit-hall amber #FFD2A0. sat 1.05, tint [1.04,1.0,0.95]. Clay 5-10% of frame, rising to 20% on the foreman.
- TITLE: black ground, clay -> ivory light line, brass sweep; clay at most 20%.
- BUTTON / END: void + one clay cursor, then a warm radial ignition; end card black + ivory mono.

MATERIALS: no glass, no transmission, no MeshPhysicalMaterial, no DOF pass. BRASS = a MeshStandard body #4A3626 (metalness 0.9, roughness 0.35) whose read comes from EMISSIVE SEAMS: glowBox edges:true or 0.4u-thick glowBox strips in #E8B47A (k 0 unlit, k 3 Act I gates, k 6 lit foreman). OBSIDIAN = MeshStandard #0B0B0C (roughness 0.6, metalness 0.3). CARDS = glowBox 3 x 0.5 x 2, #E8E6DF, emissive k 1.2, edges on. AGENTS = orb (clay k 10 / ice k 4 / ivory k 6). FLOOR = MeshStandard #0A0A0B (roughness 0.35, metalness 0.2) + grid({y:0.01, cell:2, color:'#1A2430', fade:true}).

LIGHT: HDR emissives k 2-20 carry the image; bloom threshold 0.75 (0.9 on type shots), strength 0.9 (1.6 on hits). The stage() key light is dimmed to 0.15 in Acts I-II so the frame stays 70-85% black. The human is always rim-lit from behind (point light, 2u behind, intensity 2, distance 12: ice #CFE3F2 in Acts I-II, amber #FFD2A0 in Act III). Light banks are beam() shafts through fog. Dust motes: particles(1,500, size 1.5px, #CFE3F2 or #FFD2A0) drifting 0.6u/s, visible only inside beams.

FOG and DEPTH: FogExp2, color #07090B. Hall density 0.005 (an object 200u away keeps about 37% contrast). Plant shots use 0.006 so the foreman at 260u keeps about 20% (reads as dark architecture). Macro shots use 0.02. Depth of field is FAKED by fog, scale and 3-4 geometry layers; never rack focus.

THE HALL (one set, reused by every 3D shot): floor x -300..300, z -290..90. No visible ceiling: 40 PILLARS (glowBox 2 x 120 x 2, slate #141413, edge lines ice #5B7A93 k 0.3 in Acts I-II, brass #E8B47A k 1.5 in Act III) in two rows at z = +30 and z = -30, x = -285 + 30i (i = 0..19); their tops dissolve into fog. THE LINE runs along z = 0 from x = -70 to x = +70 (140u): a 0.15u conveyor hairline (fatLine, ivory k 2) at y = 1.2 with 7 STATIONS. THE FOREMAN stands behind the line at (0, 0, -200), facing +z, 196u tall. The MONTH GATES stand on the approach rail at x = -250, -210, -180, -155, -135 (z = 0). Eight LIGHT BANKS hang at y = 60 over the line.

MOTIF RULES:
- The clay cursor/spark blinks on the music tick every time it appears: quarter notes = human speed; 8ths (double time) from OPUS 4.5 SHIPS; it stays ON in the final frame.
- Clay means Claude. Anything Claude did is clay; anything Claude did not do (Google's study, Cursor's lock jam, the human-speed review cursor) is ice or ivory.
- The foreman is planted three times as unlit architecture (shots i-human-plant, i-tower-plant, ii-plant-3), always telephoto-compressed and fogged, and is never framed as an object until it lights radially from its core in iii-foreman-hero.
- Every Act II problem composition returns in Act III through the SAME camera function (see shared cam* entries).
- Red is a pinpoint, never a field. Errors at x4.4 keep exactly 4 residual red tendrils.

- Colors: claims ivory; clay ('hot') only on Claude tokens (OPUS 4.5, RUNS, 5.5, the title); danger red only for Act II station stamps and x17.2; x4.4 is ice, never clay.
- Readable type sits on a background darkened -0.8 stop; camera at 3 deg/s or less while a card is being read.

ANGLE GRAMMAR: WORM'S-EYE = threat in Act II (towers), awe in Act III (the foreman). TOP-DOWN = understanding (midpoint, funnel, error map, factory, foreman thread map); approach pitch -89.5 deg and never flip camera.up mid-move (for a static top-down set camera.up (0,0,-1) before lookAt). MACRO = mechanism and intimacy (cursor, two writers, one writer). FPV = speed (gates, launch). TELEPHOTO 135-200mm = compression (the foreman plants, the card wall). Acts I-II: handheld 0.3 deg and Dutch 6-12 deg. From the Act III turn frame on: zero handheld, level horizon, symmetry, L->R flow.
motifs: M1 THE CLAY SPARK. A clay cursor block blinks on the tick at the one station (Act I), ignites and breaks the tick into double time when Opus 4.5 ships, multiplies into the code tower, is lost and dimmed to 30% inside the cold flat swarm (Act II), returns transformed as the foreman's core with 12 threads (Act III), and in the final frame stops blinking and stays ON.

M2 THE LINE + REFRAIN. Midpoint: one lit box (CODE, sized 16% of the line) on a dark 7-station line. Act II: the same stations jam into towers, with THE LINE WAITS. shown twice in the same slot. Turn: the 8 banks switch on one per beat and the refrain flips to THE LINE RUNS. on the mirror frame. The REVIEW / TEST / DEPLOY / human-under-tower / error-map compositions all return lit.

M3 THE CLOCK. The tick on every beat under Act I becomes accelerating Risset ticks through the five brass MONTH gates (lintel pips light 1..5), survives every music stop (midpoint, drop), and returns alone at 120 BPM in the button, where the counter rolls MONTH 0 -> 1.

M4 THE PLANT. The dark stepped mass at the back of the hall: seen as an unexplained colossus in the cold open, as architecture in three telephoto plants, and as the foreman when it lights radially from its core.

M5 THE HUMAN (1.8u scale anchor). At the one station (I), dwarfed under the red 300u tower (II), at the foreman's foot handing up one light-card brief (III), and recalled under the lit tower at the peak. It pays off FROM ONE HUMAN BRIEF.

Key D minor over a D pedal; 5-note motif D-F-A-G-F. 120 BPM (beat 0.5 s) from 0:00 to the Act III bank cascade, 150 BPM (beat 0.4 s, 8th 0.2 s) from the first bank through the title, back to 120 BPM for the button and end so the clock tick returns at its Act I rate. Per-shot music uses only the arranger vocabulary (section / chord / div / energy / add / drop).

COLD 0:00-0:08 (cold): f0 impact + sub_drop + tick; 8th preview pulse; riser 0.5->2.0; reverse swell ending 2.0; BRAAM #1 (D1) + impact + sub_drop at 2.0; boom + bell ping at 4.0; reverse swell into 6.0; low impact + tape_stop rewind at 6.0; single tick at 7.5.

ACT I 0:08-0:36 (act1): 8-14 drone + tick on every beat only (energy 0.2). MOOD CHANGE #1 at 14.0 (OPUS 4.5 SHIPS): pulse + ostinato + kick enter in 8ths 'x..x..x.x..x..x.' (Dm | Bb | C | Dm, 2 bars each) - the music starts moving with the product. 16.0-28.0: div 16, Risset ticks accelerate under the MONTH gates (whoosh peaks at the gate passes 16.75 / 20.5 / 23.5 / 26.0 / 27.75). 28.0: 2 s riser into 30.0 impact A + sub (CAPABILITY -> BUDGET). 30-34 groove with hits every 2 beats; 35.5 suckback into SILENCE #1.

SILENCE #1 36.0-36.5. MIDPOINT 36.0-42.5 (turn): the tick alone over a D drone; boom + ping at 40.5 (16%); 1 s riser into 42.5.

ACT II 42.5-72.5 (act2): MOOD CHANGE #2 on the 42.5 boom: pulse ostinato in 8ths, Dm-Bb-C-Dm, hit on every bar. Tricolon 48.5 tom / 49.5 tom+metal / 50.5 tom+metal+sub. Heartbeat from 52.5 (refrain #2). 54.5 the pulse goes to 16ths (3+3+2) as the reflex is typed. Glitch bursts 59.3 / 60.0 / 63.0 / 72.0 (4 in total). 64.0 tape_stop slice on the topple. 66.5-72.5 accelerando: 6 s noise riser + Shepard bed, kick on every cut (1.0 -> 0.5 -> 0.25 s), stutter on the last bar; riser hard-ends at 72.5.

SILENCE #2 72.5-73.5 (the drop): digital zero. 73.5 one tick; typing clicks; sub thumps 74.75 / 75.25; 0.75 s suckback ends 76.5.

TEMPO LIFT 76.5 (150 BPM): 8 bank clunks, one per beat (76.5 ... 79.3), each lower and bigger, over a 3.2 s riser + string swell; pre-hit dip on the last 8th.

MOOD CHANGE #3 at 79.7 (act3): BRAAM #2 (D1) + impact + sub_drop; climax theme with the Bb -> D major lift, 16th ostinato, hits on beats 1 and 3. Structure tricolon on GRAPH / HIERARCHY / SWARM adds a layer each (boom -> boom+impact -> boom+impact+sub). x4.4 lands on an impact with counter clicks and NO healing chime (errors are reduced, not gone). 94.9 dip to pad only (stillness). 95.3 light with NO sound. 95.7 BRAAM #3 (A1, short) + tier-S impact + sub_drop on the 5.5 engraving (the delayed boom); motif statement #2 on full brass pad; 96.9 boom as the foreman lights. Proofs: impact on each card (101.7 / 105.3), metal 310 / 370 Hz.

PEAK 109.7-114.9 (peak): hit on every beat, the wordless tricolon at 112.1 / 112.5 / 112.9, 8ths through the recall flurry; 4 s noise riser + snare roll; tape_stop on the last 8th; reverse swell ends at 114.9.

SILENCE #3 114.9-115.7 (false stop). 115.7 TITLE: BRAAM #4, a D1+A1 power chord with no third (Dsus) + impact 0 dB + sub_drop + logo shimmer; tail left unresolved.

BUTTON (120 BPM) from 120.5: the tick returns alone at -26 dB on every beat; motif statement #3 on a single high piano line; bell on the MONTH 1 roll (121.5); micro-sting (chirps + impact -12 + bell) on BUDGETS IN EARLY 2027. (124.0); final sting when the cursor stops blinking (128.0) and the tick stops with it; pad tail decays below -60 dBFS by 133.5.

acts.name: COLD OPEN: flash-forward + rewind
acts.purpose: Show the lit factory first, degraded and too fast to spend. Land the thesis number on BRAAM #1 (WAVE ONE / ≈5 MONTHS.), ask THE NEXT ONE? (asked, never claimed), then rewind every light to darkness and collapse to one clay cursor.
acts.grade: Warm but withheld: fog x2, exposure -1 stop, sat 0.9, clay at most 10%. The rewind drains to cold steel.

acts.name: ACT I: ONE STATION (wave one)
acts.purpose: A single cursor in a vast dark hall. Agents don't work; then Opus 4.5 ships and the music starts moving (ostinato at 14.0). MONTH 1->5 gates accelerate (4 / 3 / 2.5 / 2 s) to a budget ledger: capability becomes budget. The foreman is planted twice as architecture.
acts.grade: Cold: void #050506, steel #5B7A93, ice #CFE3F2; sat 0.8. Clay is the only warm hue (2% -> 5%). Handheld 0.3 deg, Dutch 6-10 deg.

acts.name: MIDPOINT: code was one station
acts.purpose: The re-read. One 4 s pull-back to top-down: the blazing station is one lit box on a dark 7-station line. The CODE segment lights IN PLACE at exactly 16% of the line length: writing code is 16% of developer time.

acts.name: ACT II: THE JAMMED LINE (30 s)
acts.purpose: Every shot adds new information: agent-speed output -> slam into human-speed review -> funnel -> THE LINE WAITS. -> REVIEW. TEST. DEPLOY. -> the whole line jammed (plant 3) -> the human under the tower -> 'just add more agents.' -> towers double -> two writers crack one card -> x17.2 -> lock jam -> wildfire -> topple -> backpressure climbs the line station by station -> alarm banks -> everything at maximum.
acts.grade: Cold desaturated (sat 0.75), ice whites, alert red #FF453A only as pinpoints (1% or less), clay dimmed to 30%. Dutch 8-12 deg, handheld.

acts.name: THE DROP: who runs the line?
acts.purpose: Valence low point: black, 1 s of true silence, then one typed question.

acts.name: ACT III: LIGHTS ON (the software factory + the foreman), 150 BPM
acts.purpose: Banks ignite one per beat -> the 79.7 turn frame (mirror + refrain flip + Dutch righting + letterbox snap + BRAAM #2) -> THE SOFTWARE FACTORY. as a Powers-of-Ten zoom -> graph / hierarchy / swarm -> x17.2 -> x4.4 (same study, neutral node, residual red) -> mirror tour -> stillness -> light before sound -> 5.5 -> the foreman lights radially from its core and the human's brief rides a thread into it -> 2 sourced proofs (structure, one session -> a dozen) -> peak with bookends and a wordless tricolon -> suckback.
acts.grade: Warm: clay / ember / brass / ivory / amber, sat 1.05. Zero handheld, level horizons, symmetry, L->R flow.
acts.letterbox: Snaps open from 2.39 to full frame (0 px) on the 79.7 braam frame; full frame after that.

acts.name: FALSE STOP + TITLE
acts.purpose: 0.8 s black silence, then BRAAM #4 lands the title CLAUDE OPUS 5.5, held 4.8 s.
acts.grade: Black ground, clay -> ivory light line, brass sweep; clay at most 20%.

acts.name: BUTTON: MONTH 1
acts.purpose: The Act I hall composition returns at the same framing with the tick back. MONTH 0 -> 1, the labelled projection lands while the hall ignites radially, then the lone cursor blinks three times and stops blinking: it stays ON.
acts.grade: Void + clay, then a warm radial ignition; the final frame is one clay cursor and a flare.

acts.name: END CARD: the true credit
acts.purpose: A true credit that proves the thesis: the film was made with Claude Opus 5.5 agents from one human brief. The only fade in the film (last 15 f).

shared.name: hallSet
shared.spec: src/shared/hall.js buildHall(scene, state) where state is 'cold'|'dark'|'alarm'|'lit'. Floor plane x -300..300, z -290..90, MeshStandard #0A0A0B roughness 0.35 metalness 0.2, plus grid({y:0.01, cell:2, color:'#1A2430', fade:true}). 40 pillars glowBox(2,120,2) slate #141413 at z=+30 and z=-30, x=-285+30i (i=0..19), edges ice #5B7A93 k0.3 (dark/alarm) or brass #E8B47A k1.5 (lit). shared.name: lineStations
shared.spec: 7 station boxes on z=0, glowBox(w=segment-1.2, h=3, d=10) at y=1.5, slate #141413 body, edges ice #5B7A93 k0.4 when dark, amber #FFD2A0 k3 when lit. Segments along x (line length 140u, x -70..70): PLAN [-70,-50.4] c-60.2 | DESIGN [-50.4,-30.8] c-40.6 | CODE [-30.8,-8.4] c-19.6 (22.4u = EXACTLY 16.0% of the line) | REVIEW [-8.4,11.2] c1.4 | TEST [11.2,30.8] c21.0 | DEPLOY [30.8,50.4] c40.6 | OPERATE [50.4,70] c60.2 (the six non-code segments are 19.6u = 14.0% each). The CODE segment's top face carries a separate emissive strip glowBox(22.4, 0.2, 10) at y=3.1 that is the ONLY thing lit in the midpoint (clay #D97757, k 0 -> 8, drawn from its own left edge x=-30.8 to its right edge x=-8.4; never starts at the line origin).

shared.name: codeTower
shared.spec: Instanced orbs (sphere r0.35, basic:true) on the CODE station top centred at (-19.6, 3, 0): tiers of 10x10 on a 1.6u grid, tier spacing 3u. Counts by state: 10 (one row) -> 100 (one tier) -> 1,000 (10 tiers, 30u tall). Color clay #D97757, k 10 (k 3 for the 30% 'dimmed' state). Crest: ring({r:9, tube:0.25, color:'#D97757', k:8}) at y=34 when 1,000. Each orb pulses k +-20% on 8ths with a per-orb phase rand(i).

shared.name: cardTowers
shared.spec: Work cards = instanced glowBox(3,0.5,2) #E8E6DF k1.2 edges on, stacked with rotation jitter +-0.15 rad (seeded) and x/z jitter +-0.3u. REVIEW tower base (1.4, 3, 0); TEST tower base (21.0, 3, 0); DEPLOY maze = 400 cards gridlocked on 14 branching conveyor strips (glowBox 0.4 x 0.1 x 8-18, ice k0.6) over the DEPLOY footprint. Heights by shot: ii-line-waits-1 REVIEW 160 cards (80u); ii-test-tower TEST 320 (160u); ii-plant-3 REVIEW 400 (200u) + TEST 320 + DEPLOY 240 (120u); ii-line-waits-2 REVIEW 600 (300u); ii-towers-double REVIEW 600->1,200 and TEST 320->640 in one second (1,840 instances, under the 2,000 cap). Act III lit state: same instances re-colored amber #FFD2A0 k2.5 and translating +x at 6u/s (flow, not a pile), pinpoints replaced by green #6EE7A0 k4 check lamps.

shared.name: monthGates
shared.spec: 5 brass gates on the approach rail (fatLine brass #B88A5A k1.5 along z=0, y=0.05, x -300..-70) at x = -250, -210, -180, -155, -135 (spacing 40/30/25/20u so the passes accelerate). Gate = two posts glowBox(1.2,14,1.2) at z=+-6 + lintel glowBox(13.2,1.2,1.2) at y=14; body #4A3626, edges brass #F3D9B1 k3. The CODE station's clay glow is visible ahead through every gate.

shared.name: lightBanks
shared.spec: 8 overhead banks over the line at x = -70+20i (i=0..7), y=60, z=0: panel glowBox(16, 0.8, 12) facing down + beam({top:6, bottom:10, height:58, opacity:0.18}) to the floor + 1,500 dust motes inside the beams. States: OFF = panel slate edges ice k0.2, beam hidden. ALARM (Act II accelerando) = panel #FF453A k3, beam opacity 0.06, slow pulse 0.6<->1.0 on quarter notes, never full-field. Bank order = i (PLAN end first, L->R).

shared.name: ledgerRow
shared.spec: The diegetic BUDGET object (no text): a horizontal brass ledger glowBox(40, 1.2, 3) body #4A3626 edges #F3D9B1 k3, divided into 12 cells by 0.2u ivory hairlines, hanging at y=36 in front of the code tower at (-19.6, 36, 14). On the stamp frame one cell (cell 7) fills clay #D97757 k 0 -> 10 in 2 f and a dust burst fires (particles 1,500, ivory, radial 6u over 0.8 s, drag).

shared.name: railNetwork
shared.spec: Cold-open and factory floor network: 1,000 instanced glowBox(L, 0.08, 0.25) rails (L 6-24u seeded) on a 4u grid over x -200..200, z -160..60, 70% along x and 30% along z, forming a circuit-board pattern that converges on the line. Emissive amber #FFB070. Cascade: rail i lights (k 0 -> 6, 2 f) when t > dist(rail_i, (-19.6,0,0)) / 160 u/s (radial outward from CODE). Rewind = the same cascade run backwards. Lamp posts for the FPV: instanced glowBox(0.3,4,0.3) along z=41.5 every 10u, tip k6.

shared.name: foremanZiggurat
shared.spec: THE FOREMAN (#1 hero). Origin (0,0,-200), faces +z. Seven stacked glowBox tiers, obsidian body #0B0B0C: T1 120x18x120 (y0-18), T2 96x18x96 (18-36), T3 74x18x74 (36-54), T4 54x20x54 (54-74) = the ziggurat; T5 30x60x30 (74-134), T6 22x40x22 (134-174) = the obelisk shaft; T7 pyramidion 14x20x14 tapering to 2x2 (174-194); crest ring({r:5, tube:0.3}) at y=196. T6 is built from 4 slabs leaving a 3u-wide vertical slot on its +z face (y 136-172) through which the CORE shows: orb r4 at (0,150,-195), clay #D97757 k20 (ember #FF8A5C bloom). BRASS SEAMS: 0.4u glowBox strips on every tier's top perimeter (28 strips) + 4 vertical corner strips on each of T5-T7 (12 strips), #E8B47A. Engraving: textPlane '5.5' brass, emissive 1.2, 8u tall, on T4's front face at (0, 64, -172.8). Beams: 4 beam() shafts from the crest down onto the tops of T1-T4 (warm ivory, opacity 0.12). UNLIT (cold open rewind, Acts I-II, Act III before the reveal): seams #3A2E22 k0, core k0, beams hidden; it reads only by rim and by red/clay light reflected from the hall. LIT: seam segment s turns on (k 0 -> 6, 2 f) when t > |centre_s - core| / 120 u/s, so light spreads radially from the core outward and downward (whole structure lit in about 1.6 s); core k 0 -> 20 with 1.3x overshoot first.

shared.name: foremanThreads
shared.spec: ONE session -> A DOZEN: exactly 12 primary threads = 12 fatLines (width 3px, gradient clay #D97757 at the core -> amber #FFB070) from the core (0,150,-195) through control point (0.5*x_j, 110, -100) to 12 SUB-LEAD nodes, orb r1.6 clay k10, at (x_j, 40, -12) with x_j = -66 + 12j (j=0..11). Sub-threads are NOT lines: flow({curves: 84 splines (7 per sub-lead) from each sub-lead down to points on the station tops (y3, z0) under it, count 6,000, speed 0.5, size 1.6, color '#FFB070'}).
